operations.title: Inspect
operations.intent: Inspect concrete state and return evidence-backed observations.

operations.title: Audit
operations.intent: Audit controls, invariants and gaps against explicit criteria.

operations.title: Inventory
operations.intent: Inventory relevant assets, dependencies and obligations.

operations.title: Map
operations.intent: Map components, flows, ownership and dependencies.

operations.title: Analyze
operations.intent: Analyze supplied evidence for patterns, causes and implications.

operations.title: Detect
operations.intent: Detect anomalies, risks, contradictions and missing controls.

operations.title: Classify
operations.intent: Classify findings into actionable engineering categories.

operations.title: Diagnose
operations.intent: Diagnose supported causal mechanisms without inventing runtime facts.

operations.title: Trace
operations.intent: Trace relationships from sources to dependent outcomes.

operations.title: Correlate
operations.intent: Correlate independent signals while preserving evidence boundaries.

operations.title: Profile
operations.intent: Profile distributions, hotspots and behavior from supplied measurements.

operations.title: Review
operations.intent: Review artifacts against domain-specific engineering criteria.

operations.title: Measure
operations.intent: Measure supplied metrics and derive explicit deltas.

operations.title: Baseline
operations.intent: Establish an evidence-backed baseline for later comparison.

operations.title: Compare
operations.intent: Compare alternatives or snapshots using consistent criteria.

operations.title: Score
operations.intent: Score options with explicit factors, assumptions and evidence coverage.

operations.title: Assess
operations.intent: Assess risk, readiness and control sufficiency.

operations.title: Evaluate
operations.intent: Evaluate state against declared objectives and constraints.

operations.title: Validate
operations.intent: Validate invariants and acceptance conditions without fabricating passes.

operations.title: Verify
operations.intent: Verify claims only when linked host evidence supports them.

operations.title: Benchmark
operations.intent: Benchmark supplied measurements against targets or baselines.

operations.title: Estimate
operations.intent: Estimate impact, effort or exposure while exposing uncertainty.

operations.title: Simulate
operations.intent: Simulate bounded scenarios; outputs are hypotheses, not observed facts.

operations.title: Forecast
operations.intent: Forecast directional outcomes from supplied trends and assumptions.

operations.title: Model
operations.intent: Build a structured model of states, dependencies and constraints.

operations.title: Prioritize
operations.intent: Prioritize actions by severity, value, dependency and evidence.

operations.title: Triage
operations.intent: Triage issues into response classes and escalation paths.

operations.title: Advise
operations.intent: Generate decision support with alternatives and tradeoffs.

operations.title: Plan
operations.intent: Build an ordered plan with dependencies, gates and evidence requirements.

operations.title: Design
operations.intent: Design a coherent solution with boundaries and acceptance conditions.

operations.title: Architect
operations.intent: Create architecture structure, interfaces, invariants and tradeoffs.

operations.title: Generate
operations.intent: Generate implementation-grade specifications from supplied constraints.

operations.title: Build
operations.intent: Build a host-executable blueprint while separating planning from execution.

operations.title: Optimize
operations.intent: Optimize stated objectives without weakening mandatory controls.

operations.title: Harden
operations.intent: Create a hardening plan that reduces attack and failure exposure.

operations.title: Remediate
operations.intent: Create prioritized remediation actions tied to findings.

operations.title: Refactor
operations.intent: Create behavior-preserving refactoring steps and regression obligations.

operations.title: Migrate
operations.intent: Create a staged migration plan with compatibility and rollback gates.

operations.title: Upgrade
operations.intent: Create an evidence-aware upgrade plan with rollback checks.

operations.title: Rollback
operations.intent: Create a safe rollback strategy with prerequisites and verification.

operations.title: Recover
operations.intent: Create a recovery route using verified recovery evidence.

operations.title: Instrument
operations.intent: Design instrumentation and automated evidence collection.

operations.title: Orchestrate
operations.intent: Orchestrate dependent steps without claiming host execution.

operations.title: Coordinate
operations.intent: Coordinate actors, queues, handoffs and evidence obligations.

operations.title: Reconcile
operations.intent: Reconcile conflicting states into an explicit resolution workflow.

operations.title: Diff
operations.intent: Build a semantic difference analysis and required reverification.

operations.title: Test
operations.intent: Build or evaluate domain-specific tests without claiming unobserved execution.

operations.title: Fuzz
operations.intent: Design adversarial and boundary cases without claiming runtime fuzzing occurred.

operations.title: Enforce
operations.intent: Evaluate enforcement requirements and block unsupported transitions.

operations.title: Gate
operations.intent: Apply an evidence-first gate returning pass, blocked or unavailable.

operations.title: Automate
operations.intent: Design deterministic automation with explicit triggers, guards and evidence.

operations.title: Schedule
operations.intent: Design safe scheduled execution with concurrency and retry controls.

operations.title: Trigger
operations.intent: Define event-driven triggers with idempotency and authorization guards.

operations.title: Observe
operations.intent: Define continuous observation loops with signal quality requirements.

operations.title: Alert
operations.intent: Define actionable alert conditions with routing and suppression controls.

operations.title: Escalate
operations.intent: Define severity-based escalation paths with ownership and approval boundaries.

operations.title: Contain
operations.intent: Design containment actions that limit blast radius.

operations.title: Isolate
operations.intent: Design isolation boundaries for failing or untrusted components.

operations.title: Throttle
operations.intent: Design throttling controls using capacity and error signals.

operations.title: Balance
operations.intent: Design load balancing and failure-aware distribution strategy.

operations.title: Replicate
operations.intent: Design replication strategy with consistency and recovery obligations.

operations.title: Shard
operations.intent: Design partitioning strategy with hotspot and rebalance safeguards.

operations.title: Cache
operations.intent: Design cache policy, invalidation and consistency safeguards.

operations.title: Index
operations.intent: Design indexing strategy tied to workload and freshness evidence.

operations.title: Serialize
operations.intent: Define serialization contracts with compatibility and evolution rules.

operations.title: Checkpoint
operations.intent: Design checkpoint strategy with integrity and restore verification.

operations.title: Replay
operations.intent: Design deterministic replay with deduplication and ordering controls.

operations.title: Canary
operations.intent: Design canary automation with success criteria and rollback triggers.

operations.title: Progressive Delivery
operations.intent: Design staged delivery automation with evidence-driven promotion gates.

operations.title: Attest
operations.intent: Build an evidence-backed attestation without inventing signatures or execution.

operations.title: Certify
operations.intent: Evaluate certification readiness from supplied evidence; no unsupported certification claims.
